notes: GROUPED on `Contractnummer` (CoNu, `key: true`), the Abonnementen pattern: FiContract is the kop and FiContractline the regel, and the sheet states both flat on one row. A contract with one regel is one row; a contract with several repeats its kop columns on each regel row under the same Contractnummer. That is also why the rule set does not make Contractnummer `unique`.

Contractnummer is filled in by Nymbus, not by the client (row 2 of the sjabloon says so), and the rule set makes it required — a sheet is only ready to send once Nymbus has numbered it. SeNo (Volgnummer contract) is left to AFAS.

The connector's two Valuta fields: CuId on the kop is the mandatory one and is fed by the `Valuta` column (default EUR through the rule set's `default-if-empty`, matching the sjabloon's 'Leeg = euro'). CuId on FiContractline is left unmapped.

`Genereren verplichting` (kolom 29, values 0-6 from the Hulptabel) goes to VaCm, the field whose allowed values are exactly those seven codes. FiContractline also has a boolean `GCoF` with the same label; it is left unmapped — whether AFAS wants it set alongside VaCm is not known yet and should be confirmed with a test record.

`Kostenplaats` goes to DiC1 (Code verbijzonderingsas 1). FiContractline has no field called kostenplaats, only the five verbijzonderingsassen, and which axis is the kostenplaats is set up per AFAS environment. Axis 1 is the usual one; check it against the customer's inrichting and correct this per client mapping if it differs.
NOT MAPPED — `Contactpersoon` (kolom 7): FiContract has no contactpersoon field on the kop or the regel (all 27 + 32 fields checked against live metainfo).

NOT MAPPED — VaPe (Contractwaarde per, J/K/M/P/T): the sjabloon describes `Contractwaarde` as 'het totale bedrag van het contract', which reads as VaPe = T, but VaPe only applies to Contractwaarde o.b.v. 02 and a mapping cannot fill a field for some rows only. Whether AFAS defaults it is to be confirmed with a test record.
NOT MAPPED — UnId (Administratie): the sjabloon has no column for it. In a multi-administratie environment that is needed before the first send.

Values that need NO translation: Type contract (VaCt — though see below), Looptijd verlenging (VaPr: M1/M3/M6/M9/J1-J10), Contractwaarde o.b.v. (VaRV: 01/02), Cyclus facturering leverancier (VaCy: W4/M1/M3/M6/J1) and Genereren verplichting (VaCm: 0-6) are all AFAS's own codes in the Hulptabel. The J/N columns feed boolean fields and `afasValue()` reads J/N as true/false.

Type contract: AFAS's VaCt lists 01 Verzekering, 02 Onderhoud, 03 Abonnement, 04 Huur- en leasecontracten, 05 Certificaat, 06 Sponsoring, 07 Raamcontract, but the sjabloon's own example row uses `OO`. Left as a straight column and validated on length only until the codetabel arrives.

Left out on purpose: the `Vrij Veld 1-8` columns (client-specific, they belong in a client mapping), and every connector field no column feeds — Valutakoers, Datum waardering, Opgezegd op/door, Eenmalig contract, Loonsom, % G-rekening, Volgnummer contractregel, Projectfase, Itemcode, verbijzonderingsassen 2-5, Bewakingscode, Type projectkosten, Btw-code, Btw-terugvordering.
